qa_posts.author: Aarav (1st Year B.Tech CSE)
qa_posts.title: How do I connect my FastAPI backend to local Ollama gemma3:1b without CORS errors?
qa_posts.body: I pulled gemma3:1b in Ollama and it works in terminal, but how should I call localhost:11434 from Python FastAPI?

comments.author: Sneha (2nd Year CSE)
comments.text: Use the Python `requests` library inside your FastAPI route to POST to `http://localhost:11434/api/chat` with `"stream": False`, and serve your HTML directly from FastAPI so both run on port 8000!

qa_posts.author: Karthik (1st Year B.Tech ECE)
qa_posts.title: Best 100% free simulator to practice ESP32 and Embedded C before buying hardware?
qa_posts.body: I just joined 1st year ECE and want to build IoT projects without spending money on components yet.

comments.author: Rahul (3rd Year ECE)
comments.text: Use Wokwi (wokwi.com)! It simulates ESP32, Arduino, OLED displays, and ultrasonic sensors 100% free in your browser.
